verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say integrations can 'trigger automations, eliminate manual work' and that developers can 'ship new reusable workflow blocks.' Event subscriptions such as create_item and change_column_value support the trigger side, and scheduled automation of status updates is also claimed. Together these point to a trigger-and-action automation capability, but the pack never describes the rule builder itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a trigger→action rule builder (when X, do Y) and its available triggers/actions/conditions, plus hands-on or independent corroboration that the rules work.
